title: Model Integration
summary: This module provides a unified interface for interacting with various AI models, handling requests, streaming responses, and managing model-specific configurations and fallbacks.

nodes.label: Model Interface
nodes.title: Model Interface
nodes.description: Defines the core abstract classes and interfaces for AI models and their streamed responses, ensuring consistent interaction patterns across different model implementations.

nodes.label: Model Implementations
nodes.title: Model Implementations
nodes.description: Concrete implementations for various AI models like Gemini, OpenAI, and Function models, handling their specific API interactions and data formats.

nodes.label: Stream Management
nodes.title: Stream Management
nodes.description: Manages the asynchronous streaming of model responses, including event processing, cancellation, and partial result aggregation for various providers.

nodes.label: Tool Forcing Logic
nodes.title: Tool Forcing Logic
nodes.description: Handles model-specific logic for forcing tool use, ensuring compatibility with different AI providers and their unique capabilities.

nodes.label: Usage & Metadata Mapping
nodes.title: Usage and Metadata Mapping
nodes.description: Translates model-specific usage details and metadata into a standardized internal format for consistent reporting and analysis.

nodes.label: Model Wrappers & Orchestration
nodes.title: Model Wrappers and Orchestration
nodes.description: Provides mechanisms for extending model functionality, enforcing concurrency limits, and orchestrating multiple models (e.g., fallback models).

nodes.label: Model Settings & Messages
nodes.title: Model Settings and Messages
nodes.description: Manages configuration parameters for AI models and defines standardized message formats for communication, including prompts and responses.

nodes.label: HTTP Client Cache
nodes.title: Cached HTTP Client
nodes.description: Provides a cached asynchronous HTTP client for efficient and reusable network connections to model providers, reducing latency and resource usage.

nodes.label: MCP Integration
nodes.title: MCP Integration
nodes.description: Handles integration with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for sampling models and managing server sessions, enabling advanced model interaction patterns.

nodes.label: Outlines Integration
nodes.title: Outlines Integration
nodes.description: Integrates with the Outlines library to support structured generation with non-API based models, leveraging various local backends.

nodes.label: AI Core
nodes.title: AI Core
nodes.description: The foundational AI core module, providing essential utilities and base functionalities for AI operations.

nodes.label: Graph and MCP
nodes.title: Graph and MCP
nodes.description: The module responsible for graph-based computations and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server interactions.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Core Abstractions
groups.description: Defines the fundamental interfaces and base classes for all AI models and their interactions within the system.

groups.label: Model Providers
groups.title: Model Providers
groups.description: Encapsulates the specific integrations and logic for various external and internal AI model providers.

groups.label: Advanced Features
groups.title: Advanced Features
groups.description: Provides advanced capabilities such as model orchestration, fallback mechanisms, and integration with specialized model protocols and libraries.

groups.title: External Dependencies
